subject: Mark main and serverAssert as weak symbols to be overridden (#1232)
reason: The change only adds __attribute__((weak)) to main and _serverAssert and drops the --allow-multiple-definition linker flag so the unit-test binary can supply its own main/assert handler; in valkey-server itself no overriding strong symbol exists, so the linked code and all runtime behavior (commands, replication, persistence, assertion handling) are unchanged. It is a build/CI/test-infrastructure change with no behavior to reach from a running server, so no scenario is warranted.
